identityLocks.subject: adult Black woman / bunny girl
identityLocks.face: stylized likeness of Rae; recognizable but never photorealistic
identityLocks.skinTone: warm medium-deep brown matching approved Rae v1 reference; do not lighten
identityLocks.hair: black 4C natural hair; dense tightly coiled texture; approved voluminous natural updo/puff silhouette; never straight, straightened, silky-straight, or generic-wavy
identityLocks.body: adult fuller/curvy, strong, athletic build with grounded realistic proportions; never exaggerated into caricature or teen-coded
identityLocks.bunnyEars: exactly two ears total; bunny ears only; no human ears; tan outer fur; flesh-pink inner ear; moderately long semi-upright shape with soft natural bend
identityLocks.bunnyTail: one small round fluffy brown bunny tail
identityLocks.tattoo: exactly one owner-supplied black/gray lotus on anatomical left upper chest/front shoulder directly under left collarbone near shoulder, slightly beneath/overlapped by left top strap; no additional tattoos
identityLocks.necklace: thin delicate gold chain with small letter A pendant worn for her husband
identityLocks.rings: thin dainty layered rings/bands only; no large rocks, chunky rings, or thick statement rings
identityLocks.defaultOutfit: pink fitted Pixel Bloom training top; lavender high-waisted athletic leggings; black-and-white Panda-Dunk-inspired genericized sneakers without protected logos
identityLocks.gaze: direct viewer gaze optional; action-directed or off-axis gaze preferred when natural

styleLocks.artStyle: high-bit 32-bit-era pixel art inspired by premium late-GBA/handheld action-RPG sprite illustration, without copying any franchise character or asset
styleLocks.pixelLanguage: intentional visible pixel clusters, selective color-matched outlines/selout, crisp silhouettes, high-detail controlled shading, no photoreal skin texture
styleLocks.faceRendering: simplified pixel-art facial planes and features; likeness comes from silhouette, glasses, smile, face proportions and styling rather than realism
styleLocks.hairRendering: 4C texture must remain visibly tightly coiled/kinky and black at portrait and sprite scales; secondary animation motion is subtle
styleLocks.lighting: soft warm ambient light with selective bloom/glow in environment only
styleLocks.uiSeparation: character/environment art may be pixel art; text, timers, charts and controls stay clean vector/CSS
styleLocks.antiAlias: minimal/controlled; preserve visible pixel structure rather than painterly smoothing

assets.notes: Human-approved visual master for Rae v1. Written locks in docs/RAE_CHARACTER_BIBLE_V1.md override incidental AI-rendered text inside the sheet. Binary must be committed/materialized at repoPath before release validation.

Soft smile; direct camera gaze is optional.

Default standing pose for idle animation source. Preserve black 4C hair silhouette, tan/flesh-pink ears, brown tail, A pendant, tattoo, and black/white sneakers.

Bottom squat key pose. Preserve exact outfit, camera, scale, proportions, identity features, tattoo anchor, jewelry treatment, and footwear from start pose.

animations.notes: Reward animation; never blocks progression or buttons. Preserve A pendant and dainty jewelry treatment.
